This paper has compared the ACGLML method with the ACLML on Space-Amplitude diagram, and ACGLML is proved to perform better. The major task of the ACGLML method is encryption and decryption and despite that; it uses conventional wavelet based decompositions for image compression and decompression to ensure the applications in common communication channel.

articleTitle: Application of artificial intelligence and Zen space in modern landscape design and topology optimization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Application of artificial intelligence and Zen space in modern landscape design and topology optimization is studied in this manuscript. With the rapid development of the big data technology, simple machine logic has not been able to meet people's requirements for the intelligence of various electronic devices, so artificial intelligence has emerged at the historic moment. Hence, inspired by the emerging development of AI technologies, two novelties are proposed. (1) The new visual phenomenon in the context of the Internet, and cross-border and multidimensional interactions marked by visual image are analyzed with the core perspective of data mining; (2) After correction, the same metric information exists between the projection surface and the corresponding scene surface, tested on the 3D scenario. The experimental results have proven the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Voltage Sag Mitigation by using Photovoltaic based Dynamic Voltage Restorer in Barak Valley Power System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the distribution and sub-transmission system, the main power quality challenge is voltage sag. To counteract it, diverse solutions have been searched to compensate it so that financial losses in the industries can be minimized. To avoid such type of negative impact in sensitive loads where commercial factories are connected, dynamic voltage restorer (DVR) have been used. The DVR works in a series reactive power compensation principle and is located in series with the load bus and retains the capability to produce counter action quickly in opposition to the voltage sag. This paper explained series reactive power injection using photovoltaic (PV) based DVR. The recommended approach is to develop an analytical aspect which is tested in a real-time Barrak Valley sub-transmission/distribution power system to validate this approach. Some percentage of voltage sag can be exterminated by supplying reactive power. The proposed scheme of DVR incorporates a PV system connected to the DC-DC-AC converter.

articleTitle: SO-OTA Based Emulator Circuit for Extended Memristor with Hysteresis Loop of Type II
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper presents an emulator circuit using single-output operational transconductance amplifier (SO-OTA) for an extended memristor which provides a hysteretic loop of type II. The type I `pinched hysteresis' curve of the memristor usually traces in the I and III quadrant of I- V plane in anticlockwise-clockwise or clockwise-anticlockwise direction. The hysteresis curve of proposed extended memristor emulator circuit traces in the anticlockwise-anticlockwise direction in first and third quadrants of I-V plane. The Cadence simulation results are provided for design verification.

articleTitle: Evaluation Model of Integrated English Course Online Guiding Intelligent Evaluation based on Evolutionary Algorithm and Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Evaluation model of An Integrated English Course online Guiding intelligent evaluation based on the evolutionary algorithm and the data mining is designed in this paper. The proposed framework has listed novelties. (1) If multi-objective evolutionary algorithm can only have better solving ability and performance on specific problem characteristics, multi-objective evolutionary algorithm is not robust. A robust multi-objective evolutionary algorithm should be able to solve different problems with some different characteristics, and show good stability when solving problems. (2) On the premise of ensuring the quality of the solution, the operating efficiency of the core multi-objective evolutionary algorithm is also an important index for the investigation, the traditional EA model is revised to construct the novel efficient framework. The simulation compared with the state-of-the-art approaches has proven the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Maximum Power Point Tracking based Transient Analysis of Wind Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Our proposed work is to design a wind-based power generation system using Matlab 2015a version. Also, lowest transient response based three-phase power generation system is implemented. Our Proposed PI controller is to reduce all fluctuation generation across derive train generator. Renewal Energy age systems have been starting late and getting progressively more thought due to the cost power, and are condition welcoming when diverged from the non-sustainable power source and nuclear Energy age. Other than the Energy age, for instance, hydro and siphoning limit, wind control age has been considered as the most monetarily canny with making potential. The development of unit size and improvement of execution with higher stacking variable and reliability have made breeze control age logically charming and its unit age cost ends up being incredibly engaged when appeared differently in relation to oil-based commodity control age. The basic objective of by far most of the breeze imperativeness structures is to expel the most outrageous.

articleTitle: Exploring the Turning Points for Intelligent Traversal with Q-Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The real reason behind a success or failure need not be the decisions or actions taken in the immediate past, but can be an event occurred in the distant past, as mentioned in Blame Attribution problems. The crucial action points capable of influencing or even deciding the ultimate nature of future outcomes are known as Turning Points. The turning points in real life or gaming situations are similar to junctions of roads diverting to one among the more favorable, less favorable or unfavorable destinations. Intelligent systems with adaptive learning capabilities can help to identify the real turning points using score values assigned to various states transition possibilities during previous epochs. This is a study on attaining knowledge about the turning points through repeated alternate exploration epochs using a basic Q-Learning model of a maze and the scope of exploiting this knowledge during the decision making situations in the future which demand crucial selection among multiple alternative options.

articleTitle: 8:1 Radio Frequency High Power Combiner
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Power combiner used to combine the power from various solid-state amplifiers. A power combiner is essential for applications that require a larger power source for their efficient operation. Since taking inputs from multiple solid-state amplifiers is a tedious job and limits its overall power throughput. This paper proposes a design for 8:1 RF combiner, operating at radio frequency, which combines the power received at its eight input ports in one-step. The design approach is Circuit level combining based on N-way combining structure and radial combining and is analyzed using S-parameters. The simulated results show that this approach of designing 8:1 way power combiner provides a high degree of isolation, low return loss and low reflection loss with 90% efficiency and unsurpassed simplicity in design to fabricate.

articleTitle: Handling Secure Healthcare Data Streaming using R2E Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the present era, the transfer of information has increased using the internet, which cannot be reliable because any unauthorized user can tamper the data or obtain the unintended information, especially in healthcare. With the rise in the number of patient's health record, there's an increase in the number of data breaches. Healthcare data is something which sometimes can't be shared with unauthorized people because it stores lots of important personal and sensitive data. However, technologies such as cloud storage stored at any remote location (cloud) which is vulnerable to many cyber-attacks pose an adverse impression on the secrecy and safety of patient's healthcare records and require lots of security for protecting the medical information. So, protecting the confidentiality of the patient's health information is of utmost importance. This work tries to provide a better and more efficient solution for securing all the health care data that are stored on the cloud which protect health care data from unauthorized access from an unknown source.

articleTitle: Design and Development of PV-Wind based Hybrid Renewable Energy System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The conventional resources are causing extreme pollution in the earth's atmosphere. Natural reserves like coal, radioactive materials etc. may come to end soon. To overcome these problems, possible enduring action is necessary to fulfil the global energy demand and sustainable development. Therefore, it is required to switch towards non- conventional energy resources like solar and wind energy for the accomplishment of energy needs. In this paper modelling and simulation for Hybrid Renewable Energy System (HRES) using maximum power tracking (MPPT) is proposed This system is introduced to enhance power transferability to the load in different atmospheric conditions. The HRES containing two distributed energy resources namely photovoltaic energy and wind energy conversion system (WCES) is simulated in MATLAB/Simulink at various environmental conditions for various loads. The results observed by various test cases ensure that the proposed control system is efficient and capable to maintain the power transfer among the hybrid renewable energy system.

articleTitle: Implementation of Deep Learning Model for Video Colorization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Technology sometimes enhances the art and also Vandalizes. Colorizing black and white films is a very old idea dating back to 1902. For decades many movie creators opposed the idea of colorizing their black and white movies and thought of it as vandalism of their art. Today it is accepted as an enhancement to the art form. The technology itself has moved from painstaking hand colorization to today's largely automated techniques. In the last few years, with the Deep Learning revolution, automation in colorization has taken a huge leap forward. In this project, one such Deep Learning model for video colorization will be proposed and present a simple colorization methodin which the model performs object detection and imparts color based on the trained dataset to the input feed. A machine learning model have been built to automatically turn grayscale video feed into a colored video feed based on a specific dataset.

articleTitle: Application of Fuzzy C-Means Clustering and Genetic Algorithm in the Fabrication of Circuit Board
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Real world problems are full of uncertainty. Probability theory can deal with uncertainty up to a certain limit. After Newtonian mechanics, physicists along with mathematicians were trying to formulate a wide variety of theories of probability. Today also there exist relative frequency theory and the personalistic or subjectivist theory which are among the most popular ones but probability theory demands equally likely and mutually exclusive outcomes as well. Actual real world problems like optimization of laser drilling time of circuit boards, cannot be solved by the theories of probability though having uncertainty. Uncertainty is in another way just the inverse of information we have about any system. The more complex a system becomes, the less certain we can be in proper analysis of that system, its formulation and solution. Imprecise human reasoning forms the basis of our initial understanding of most physical processes but computers should be provided with precise and quantified quantities of information. The efficacy of fuzzy logic can be judged in this criterion. This context is for analyzing and ascertaining the optimality of using fuzzy logic along with genetic algorithm, while minimizing the laser drilling time of circuit boards.

articleTitle: Summary of the Intelligent Social Management Function of Ideological from the Perspective of Information Theory with MOOC Platforms
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Summary of the intelligent social management function of ideological from the perspective of information theory with MOOC platforms is conducted in this paper. MOOC is a learning concept based on relevance theory in the digital age. Its core is that information is node, knowledge is well fully connection, understanding is network interaction. This paper use the MOOC platform to conduct the study. From the technique level, the novelties are: (1) From the analysis of the balance of sex-linked groups and the analysis of their information entropy, it can be seen that the information entropy is the largest when it is balanced, which is meaningful in the location of sex-linked genetic genes. The information theory model is advanced by the mentioned operation. (2) Maximum general information entropy principle holds that entropy is a process-independent state function, that is, there is also a continuous single-valued function relationship, the traditional models are revised. The methodology proposed in the paper is tested on the application scenario of the social management function. The experimental results have then proved that the proposed method is efficient.

articleTitle: Cloud based ERP Model using Optimized Load Balancer
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Cloud computing are turning out to be increasingly more significant in the field of Information Technology (IT) furthermore, Communication. These are two distinct segments of current data frameworks, and there are a few inside and out examinations about Enterprise Resource Planning on cloud computing framework. ERP frameworks are related with a few issues, for example, shared synchronization of multi-composed assets, constrained customization, massive overhauling cost, arrangement mix, industry usefulness, reinforcement support and innovation refreshes. These issues render ERP frameworks execution excruciating, complex and time-devouring and create the need for a huge change in ERP structure to upgrade ERP frameworks foundation and usefulness. Cloud Computing (CC) stages can defeat ERP frameworks inconsistencies with financially savvy, redid and profoundly accessible figuring assets. The objective of this examination is to blend ERP and CC benefits to lessen the factor of consumption cost and execution delays through a proposed system. For this reason, investigate the unmistakable issues in current ERP frameworks through a complete correlation between ERP when moving to CC condition. Also, a conventional structure is proposed for “Cloud-based ERP frameworks”.

articleTitle: Impact of Higher Order Horizontal Sectorisation on a Real 4G Long Term Evolution Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Horizontal sectorisation has always been done irrespective of generations of cellular radio networks for the improvement of coverage and capacity. Generally, commercial deployment is restricted to three sectors due to increased interference. However one of the efficient spectra uses techniques which are explored these days to meet the huge data requirement of Next Generation wireless networks is higherorder sectorisation. Improved antenna design coupled with intelligent beamforming has enhanced the benefits of higherorder sectorisation surpassing the limitations. Performance gains by coverage and capacity are evaluated in this paper with the use of higher-order horizontal sectorisation through simulation and using real network scenario. Simulations have been carried out to assess the potential gain for the idealized Long Term Evaluation -Advanced network model in terms of the considered Key Performance Indicators of the network. The results have also been verified with the help of data obtained from live BSNL 4G network at Gangtok by deploying sites of six sectors to confirm the performance improvement with the use of higher-order sectorisation.

articleTitle: Slotted Patch Microstrip Antenna with a Fork-Like Electromagnetic Band Gap Structure
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this paper, the Electromagnetic Band Gap is presented to improvise the flexibility of the structure to enhance the outcome of dual-band microstrip slotted antenna for return loss, bandwidth and gain. The periodic fork-shaped EBG structure has been additionally designed merging to the microstripantenna proposed at frequencies 3.8 GHz & 5.05 GHz. The two band frequencies are achieved for S-band and C-band applications. Thus, experimental analysis determines the performance of the Electromagnetic band-gap element which is often strengthened by rearranging the EBG cells periodically. The efficacy using asingle element & with EBG's, inclusion with the antenna has been distinguished.

articleTitle: Design of Dual-Band Bandpass Filter on Coplanar Waveguide Using Meander Inductor
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this work, a planar dual-band bandpass filter (BPF) implemented with a meander inductor in the signal conductor strip of the conventional coplanar waveguide transmission line has been demonstrated. The proposed dual-band BPF showed the frequency response in S-band and C-band at center frequency 2.75 GHz and 4.9 GHz, with a low return loss of -32.787 dB and -29.887 dB, and with the low insertion loss of -0.832 dB and -2.27 dB respectively. The -3 dB bandwidth of frequency response in S-band and C-band is 1.55 GHz and 0.987 GHz.

articleTitle: Human Movement Analysis from the Egocentric Camera View
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this study, a method of human movement analysis is introduced according to making and utilizing human motion datasets in a first-person egocentric viewpoint using head-mounted cameras. Two steps of virtual and real tests are required to build the dataset. The blender has been used to capture the actions in the virtual mode with five thousand frames from various movements in different scenes to assure the reliability of the algorithm. Furthermore in real test 170000 frames captured in different actions from seventeen people. To recognize each act, the long short term memory architecture was utilized for the classification of the training database. In the process of this stage, the optical flow is utilized for obtaining the head and the concordance camera position, combined with the scene which is utilized for recognizing the motion pattern for each person.

articleTitle: Handoff Analysis in 5G Small Cell Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Macro and Small cell base stations (BSs) are beneficial in terms of increasing the user capacity and high data rate in wireless cellular networks. Small cells are useful farther for low cost, low transmission power, higher transmission capacity, and establishing a proper connection with the mobile user inside vehicles. This paper discusses a deterministic geometry-based system model of two-tier cellular networks. Based on the distance between a vehicle and small-cell base stations, the signal-to-interference-noise ratio (SINR), coverage probability and handoff rate have been derived for 5G small-cell networks. The handoff algorithm considers SINR, distance and radius of the cell to achieve a low handoff rate. In this paper, results show similar performance as obtained in PPP based complex arrangement of small cell base stations. Our approach provides a low complexity solution to the Handoff problem in 5G small-cells.

articleTitle: An Inventive Thought for Understanding The Passionate Needs of Individuals Who Are Blind
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The smart stick could be a procedure which allows then to avoid various obstacles on their way. Blind Individuals endure from the shortage of capacity to do their day by day exercises, from strolling within the road to going by companions or relatives or any everyday tasks. In this manner, the arrangement for this major issue is proposed by planning an adhere that can help the individual to step securely without carrying any agitation in their mind that somebody or something on their way can hit them. A savvy stick may be incredible activity for helping people who are blind. This keen stick can be a substantial approach to empower outwardly impeded individuals to discover troubles in recognizing obstacles and threats in their walking period and to recognize the world in all view. In this paper, an arrangement of a smart stick has been proposed with enchanted features like the LDR sensor to identify dark and lighted places, water indicator circuit to transmit the information of encountered groundwater and ultrasonic sensor for acknowledging nearby obstacles before the client, inside an extend of 50cm. Sonar sensors are used to learn the object's existence and to notify the user when the obstruction is too near. Light dependency resistor is a photoresistor that is an active component that reduces resistance in the responsive ground of the sensor about acquiring luminosity. Water predictor circuit includes alternative voltage that is achievable by using a unique configuration of transistors, diodes, and logic gates. The stick is competent of recognizing all the impediments within the extended period and provides a reasonable regard text through the Bluetooth and the android app engaging blind to move twice as fast as his/her general speed when they feel secure. When the proposed design system is performed in the practical phase a 96.23 % average accuracy level is encountered. The smart stick is, lightweight, low-cost product, low control utilization, quick reaction, and capable to overlay.

articleTitle: Collaborative Enhanced System for Heterogeneous IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: With the pace by which IoT devices are created nowadays, there will be numerous IoT devices in any environment, be it home or industry or anywhere else. With this rapid pace, it has become more and more difficult for device manufactures to expect that their end users have a unified homogeneous ecosystem (where every device comes from the same manufacture and are carefully developed to work in harmony so that they work with each other without any hassle) which is not in most of the cases. Thus, a solution is being proposed which allows devices from different manufactures which are meant to perform different tasks, to collaborate and use each other's knowledge to give a unified experience to the end-user, even if the actual network doesn't consist of homogeneous devices. In our proposed system, there exists a central node (central server) in every local network which communicates with each IoT device present in that network. Here the central node acts as a mediator for IoT devices to communicate with each other and share their data. Plus, any IoT device connected to the central server can also utilize its power to perform certain high-end tasks which they can't perform on their own in real-time.

articleTitle: Location based Human Behaviour Analysis on Products or Events
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: From corporate decisions like calculating the perfect target audience to political decisions like designing an act for citizens of a state, it has always been tried to predict how people of a certain community or location will react to a particular product or event. People of different regions react to a similar situation in a different manner; a topic may be a sensitive issue in one location and may seem to be like a normal one in other. Several crimes, protests and product failures can be avoided if they could simply predict the reaction of the target audience (population of a particular location) in a certain situation. In this scenario, this research work aims to analyze the behavior of people based on a different location to analyze the impact of the products/events which are to be launched. Hence, architecture is proposed to analyze how people of a given location respond to a particular event/product and this is achieved by integrating sentiment analysis, location-based data analysis, natural language processing techniques, and machine learning approach. In the end, the analysis results are used to optimize decision making and problem-solving.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Capsule Networks in Content based Image Retrieval tasks: CapsCBIR
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative study and analysis for content-based image retrieval tasks by employing two deep learning architectures - Capsule Siamese Network, and Capsule Triplet Network. The performance of these architectures are compared with various conventional feature extraction techniques as well as state-of-the-art methods in content-based image retrieval and Capsule Network as a standalone feature extractor.

articleTitle: Spectrum Sensing in OFDM using Energy Detection: A Comparative Study in AWGN and Rayleigh Channels
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing based modulation schemes has the advantage of reducing ISI in Cognitive Radios (CR). An OFDM modulation scheme for CR, with QAM and PSK symbol mapping techniques, is implemented. Spectrum sensing is carried out for this ISI free system using Energy Detection method, both in AWGN and Rayleigh fading channels. The performance of these systems is compared using ROC curves and Area under ROC's. Results of the analysis showed that QAM-OFDM in AWGN channel conditions yielded better performance for energy detection based spectrum sensing.

articleTitle: Intelligent Effectiveness Evaluation of College Ideological Guiding based on Computer Data Analysis and Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Intelligent effectiveness evaluation of the college ideological guiding based on computer data analysis is conducted in this manuscript. The novelties of the paper can be summarized as following aspects. (1) As a traditional and mature means of data management, database system is mainly used for transaction processing, the traditional models are optimized for obtaining the high efficient model. (2) When technicians use the Python for the computer network development, they can directly apply the network protocol library resources contained in Python, the proposed research work use the Python to implement the system. (3) Apriori algorithm automatically performs pruning when generating candidate sets, this model is used to construct the fuzzy evaluation model. The performance of the model is validated through the simulations.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing based Text Imputation for Malayalam Corpora
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The prediction task in Natural Language Processing intends to figure out the missing characters, letter, word, expression, or sentence that conceivable follows in a given fragment of a book. Since the beginning of NLP, numerous frameworks with various techniques were produced for various dialects. The missing content prediction is one among the significant concerns of Natural Language Processing. Moreover, most of the text prediction related tasks are conducted in different dialects but not in Malayalam. Over these years though having some of the best classics, historical records and many more to keep the world interested with, the Malayalam was lacking many of the advantages that any other language process in the digital world. This is because there are only a few standard models that could fit into the Malayalam. In this paper, an attempt is made to fit the BERT into Malayalam. A Malayalam pre-trained model will be creating and implementing some of its applications with the model and discussing its scope and areas of development to be addressed and future research scope.

articleTitle: Integrity Check in a Cognitive Radio Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Cognitive Radio (CR) can wisely detect and differentiate used and unused communication channels and utilizes the vacant channels without interrupting the occupied ones. For efficient sharing of spectrum. many CRs can form a network and function under the supervision of supervisor called Master Controller. This research work focusses on checking whether the cognitive radio can become the member of the group so that it can enjoy all the features offered by the network. To become a member of the group, the CR has to pass the test conducted by MC. The MC shoots the CR with different questions and the CR answers to the question posted by MC. If the MC gets satisfies with the answer given by CR then it accepted as the member. To avoid any the malicious intrusion the communication between CR and MC is encrypted. The data transmission between both the entities is performed using OFDM transceiver. The authentication method is based on the cryptographic algorithm named Triple Data Encryption Standard (3DES). The key used for 3DES is generated using Sanskrit sutra. Performing integrity check, allows only legitimate users to become a part of the group. After becoming a member of the group, CR can share and access all the resources provided by the group.

articleTitle: Analysis of Segmentation Techniques for Synthetic Aperture RADAR Image Processing Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Synthetic aperture RADAR (SAR) is an emerging technology primarily used for high resolution ground mapping. SAR's capability to perform under adverse weather conditions, day or night makes it advantageous for many civilian and military applications. It is an active imaging system and inherently suffers from speckle noise, which is multiplicative in nature. Speckle noise originates from the interferen'ce of the coherent wave fronts associated with the reflected signal. The quality of SAR images is significantly degraded by this interference. Conventional intensity-based image processing techniques do not perform well for SAR images because of multiplicative nature of speckle. A variety of suggested image segmentation techniques suitable for SAR images have been analysed in this paper. The paper performs comparative analysis of image segmentation techniques that are based on different features of the images and are specialized to perform on SAR images. Experiments are performed on synthetically generated images and real SAR images obtained from Moving and Stationary Target Acquisition and Recognition (MSTAR) public database.

articleTitle: The Ground Arc Extinguishing Timing Identification Based on Petersen Coil by Using Isolated Gate Bipolar Transistor (IGBT) Technique
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Neutral grounding impedance is very important for distribution networks to provide protection and ensures the safety of the persons and equipment, This paper describes a proposed circuit for controlling method of neutral grounding current when single-phase earth fault occurs. The proposed circuit is achieved by controlling the duty cycle of insulated-gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) to adjust the impedance value of the Petersen coil that connected to the neutral point and hence compensating the capacitive current. Theoretical calculations of the load current and the neutral grounding impedance have been obtained by regulating the duty cycle of IGBT. To verify the results obtained by calculations Matlab Simulink model to control neutral grounding impedance for different values of the duty cycle of IGBT and the source phase-shift angle was created. The compassion of the calculated values and simulation model results showed agreement.

articleTitle: Simulation of Performance of Air Conditioning System using Multi-nets Artificial Neural Networks (MN-ANN)
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Usually, the air conditioning systems have to be compelled to maintain temperature among an exact fascinating vary. Specially, the temperature distribution isn't spatially uniform. Having sensors put in at mounted and restricted locations cannot react to the quickly variable space conditions thanks to transient and non-stationary human behavior. This paper has a tendency to use Multi-nets Artificial Neural Networks (MN-ANN) to work out and conclude the precise or close to cooling needed for the space, supported the amount of person's gift within the space. So, with the help of typical temperature range of persons within the space, we'll able to conclude what quantity temperature we've to present to cooling or heating the space. The operation is uncontrolled and should be manually turned on and off. Typically it will cause high usage of electricity that successively raises the electricity bill once the user forgot to change it off. So in order to avoid such problems automatic controlling of air conditioning systems can be used. In this paper, the simulation of performance of air conditioning systems using MN-ANN is performed. The simulation is done using Matlab R2018a.

articleTitle: Image Processing Based Human Following Cart Using 360° Camera
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This study involves a robot that aims to follow a human target after detection, recognition, and tracking. The system has used 360 ° cameras to provide solution to the limitation of the tracking zone of a conventional camera. The image captured is in fisheye format and was then converted into a panoramic image to be processed by You Only Look Once (yOLO) Detection Algorithm to detect the human target and Channel and Spatial Reliability Tracking (CSRT) algorithm to track the target. The proponents included a 10-second target recognition methodology after detection so the system does not need to find the target from time to time.

articleTitle: Influence of Intelligent Environmental Art based on Reinforcement Learning on the Regionality of Architectural Design
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Influence of intelligent environmental art based on reinforcement learning on the regionality of architectural design is studied in this paper. Database technology is a core technology of information system, an important part of modern information science and technology, and the core of the computer data processing and information management system. This paper will adopt the advantages of the intelligent technology to construct the efficient design framework. Reinforcement learning is the process of letting agents learn actions in the environment to then obtain the maximum reward value, while deep reinforcement learning is a learning method that combines the perceptual ability of deep learning with the decision-making ability of the enhanced learning. This paper integrates the novel deep learning model to improve the traditional framework. The experiment results have proven the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Big Data Cleaning Algorithm based on Repetitive Change Detection and GANs
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Big data cleaning algorithm based on the repetitive change detection and GANs is proposed in this paper. The cost-sensitive decision tree building method based on split attribute benefit and cleaning cost is used to select split attribute with high benefit and low cleaning cost and give priority to cleaning. In each step of the decision tree establishment, the split attribute is cleaned and then used for the split. This method ensures the effectiveness of decision tree node splitting because importance of split nodes with low number of layers is higher than that of split nodes with high number of layers. Change detection methods can be divided into the pixel-level change detection and object-level change detection according to the different levels of the change detection information. Based on these complex theoretical analysis, the model is optimized and enhanced. The experiment on the GANs and the data cleaning have proven that the compared with the state-of-the-art models, the proposed model has better robustness.

articleTitle: Contingency Analysis of Low Voltage DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Microgrid concept has been widely accepted in the field of electrical engineering with the rapid evolution of electricity consumption. Microgrids are an alternative option within a distributed generation system which can offer both reliability and efficiency. The distribution of DC power can be more effective in the environment than AC power distribution due to various advantages. It provides the horizontal infrastructure to integrate distributed generation and loads. Due to its significant benefits such as reduced losses and less conversion stages, nowadays, DC MGs have been attracting growing attention. However if any line outage or generator outage occurs in DC microgrid then the system power loss and voltage profile changes. The voltage profile and system power loss are the two most important factors to show the performance of a system. This paper presents the contingency analysis of low voltage DC MG. This study presents the value of voltage and slack bus power which is responsible for providing the total system loss in different outage conditions. The Modeling of the proposed model is done in MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Construction of Intelligent University Quality Evaluation System for Ideological Work and Its Computer Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Construction of the intelligent university quality evaluation system for the ideological work and its computer applications is finalized in this paper. Novelties are reflected from listed points of views. (1) The similarity measurement between each sample point is the primary problem in the clustering algorithm. The similarity measure has the same meaning as the “distance” between the commonly mentioned samples, the novel calculation model for data distance is proposed. (2) For the three operators of the standard genetic algorithm, the choice of the operating system consumption is the largest, it is optimized by using the kernel functions. The experimental analysis has proven that the proposed model can achieve the better evaluation.

articleTitle: Design of a Tag Dipole Antenna for the RFID Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This article presents a design of tag dipole antenna with a capacitive tip loading technique to minimize the size of the antenna for RFID applications. The antenna has a simple structure with a Plexiglass substrate. In this design, the Impinj Monza R6-P electronic chip can be used with a real and imaginary impedance of 12.04 ohms and −119.6 ohms. A capacitive tip loading technique has been proposed to reduce the size of the tag dipole antenna. The simulation results show that the designed antenna structure has good results in terms of their return loss of −30.55 dB, a gain of 2.26 dB and directivity of 2.40 dB. The tag antenna has a long read range of 15.5 m.

articleTitle: A Real Time Auditing System using QR Code for Secure Cloud Storage
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The objective of the project is to structure a portable application for inspecting and putting away information through a distributed storage administration. The information is remotely put away in the cloud. In some distributed storage frameworks, the cloud record may contain some touchy data. Scrambling the entire shared record doesn't permit different clients to get to it. In the current framework the client needs to use the biometric information to guarantee the character of the client and afterward a marking key will be checked which is to ensure the personality and security of the client. The principle downside of utilizing the biometric information is that it can't be coordinated precisely because of the elements that influence the difference in biometric information. A reference id made is naturally changed over to the QR code and it is checked utilizing a scanner and the specific record is downloaded. This record whenever erased or lost in the customer's inward stockpiling it very well may be recovered again from the cloud.

articleTitle: Blockchain: The Novel Way to Secure Confidence!
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This report intends to play out a precise audit to survey and establish the practicality of blockchain for implementing healthcare service records effectively. Traditional health records are both localized and expensive to operate; they can be improved upon by using blockchain based electronic health records (EHRs). EHRs are just electronic versions of a patient's whole clinical history. EHRs, when stored on blockchain, has some serious advantages when compared to their traditional centrally stored counterparts. The patient's medical records will be stored on a distributed network. An ethereum based decentralized application (DApp) can be incorporated to record and update medical information securely in real time using smart contracts. A decentralized application on a private blockchain network will ensure the integrity of data records and improve interoperability of the system by providing permanent access to essential details like patient's medical track record, prescription history, laboratory/ clinical reports etc. The application uses the efficiency and security of blockchain technology to solve the challenges faced by the healthcare domain.

articleTitle: Memory Testing and on Board Data Handling of Satellite Payload
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The proposed study explores the regulation, operation and performance of Raspberry Pi and external memory testing in space. Design of onboard data handling using raspberry pi, IR temperature sensor, atmospheric pressure sensor and UV sensor measuring non-contact temperature, pressure conditions and UV radiations resnectively in space had been drained this research. During this research, the watchdog also designed to avoid command because of data accumulation from sensors. By Implementing the encryption principle highly secured data will be exchanged, hence the info can't be hacked. This project implemented using Python language.

articleTitle: A Neoteric Speaker Verification System Using Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Automatic Speaker Verification (ASV) systems are mostly being used for authentication of a known identity based on different voice features. The ASV involves a comparison of a speaker's voice with pre-stored training data or speaker model captured during the enrolment phase and also with an impersonator model of non-identical voices differing in gender as well as phone types. Thereafter, a score is assigned by the system and decides whether the test speaker is an enrolled speaker or an imposter. In the comprehensive classification of a certain problem, one of the most important processes is feature subset selection. It includes dimensionality reduction, attribute subset selection and variable subset selection and also an important step to reduce overfitting of data. This paper presents one of the methods to solve this feature selection problem using Ant Colony Optimization algorithm. This algorithm subsumes the performance of the classification into state transition rule. The optimal feature set is determined with the help of the pheromone from the ant colony. Finally, a feature set with maximum classification accuracy and small size is selected.

articleTitle: Towards Sentiment Analysis: A powerful technique for Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: With the advancement of cyberspace of social networking, blogging and micro-blogging websites increasing popularity, leads to an enormous increase in the amount of informal subjective text statements which are made available online for better understanding. Sentiment Analysis is the mindset, emotion for individual analytical research. It has become more important for the growth of the business, political issues, and for different customer. The data mining is the most common field of computer science for analysis of data. In this paper, various approaches have been described and also discussed the different principles and techniques that are used for sentiment analysis using a tool called Weka. This dataset is used to optimize classification of data using different types of the algorithm (Naïve Bayes, Support Vector Machine, Decision tree etc.) to findout the performance analysis of each algorithm to get best and accurate results.

articleTitle: Advanced Memory Management Unit for 3-D Network on Chip
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Future generation chip multiprocessor (CMP) contains thousands of cores to increase performance the system. Network on Chip (NoC) is new paradigm for the intercommunication of System on Chip (SoC). 3-D NoC is the new way of improvement in NoC fabric to achieve high performance. One of major drawbacks of NoC is memory unit and it is proportionally increases in 3-D NoC. A first in first out (FIFO) is conventionally placed in NoC router to store data packet temporarily. The memory is critical issue for NoC based SoC because of size and cost of device. Advanced memory architecture presented to optimize the performance of NoC router. This paper proposes a random access memory (RAM), which is a bridge between input ports and crossbar switch. This technique is simulated in Xilinx 14.7 ISE and implemented in Vertex-6 FPGA device.

articleTitle: Implementation of Online Guiding Framework based on Multimedia and PHP under the Influence of New Coronavirus
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Implementation of the online guiding framework based on the multimedia and PHP under the influence of new Coronavirus is studied in this paper. The construction of guiding resources based on the COOC platform can give full play to characteristics of collaboration, integrate the advantages of the multiple guiders, majors, and universities to form a high-quality resource pool, which ultimately helps to form comprehensive and rich teaching resources, which can achieve co-construction of resources, share, learn from each other. The core idea of constructing a website based on Linux, Apache, MySQL and the PHP platform is to carry Apache service running environment on the Linux operating system, and based on this ideas, this paper proposes the PHP framework for the systematic construction. The efficient model is designed for evaluating the performance, and the fuzzy clustering with data mining analytic framework is jointly proposed for analysis. The experiment has proven that the proposed model has better robustness.

articleTitle: Dynamic Channel State Information based Relay Selection in Device-to-Device Communication
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Relay selection in Device-to-Device (D2D) communication network is a prominent task due to the imperfect channel conditions and sensing intervals. This paper presents a dynamic channel state interval (CSI) based feedback design for improving the features of relay selection to improve the performance of the D2D communication networks. Based on the dynamic detection of imperfect channel conditions and sensing intervals, the precoding process is employed for the signal derivative in the relay selection process. The relay with a high order of signal output determines its selection. The performance of the proposed method is verified for the sum rate metric for the varying CSI bits, transmit power and inter-user distance.

articleTitle: Open Simulator for Digital Circuit based Virtual Experiments
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper provides an extensive overview of modelling. The simulation model being proposed is an OPEN-SIMULATOR for digital circuit based virtual experiments. A requirement of a number of hardware parts in real life occurs when it comes to installing an electrical circuit for testing and this phase is not economic in most cases. Visualizing a circuit, finding errors and then rectifying them or looking for a workaround explicitly for R&D purposes is not very feasible. Our proposed simulation and modeling method is the solution to this technical fragility. It also made use of examples at every step of the development process to illustrate the application of the methodology. This paper reflects on why the simulated system is secure and cost-free for the same physical system that threatens to break down.

articleTitle: A Perturbation based Algorithm for Inference of Gene Regulatory Networks for Multiple Myeloma
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The expression of genes within the body of an organism is responsible for manufacturing normal proteins and other molecular compounds required for normal operation of the cell and whole body. Often the genes influence each other and the activity of one gene leads to activation or deactivation of one or more other genes. Such groups of interacting genes is known as a gene regulatory network. Many computational researchers have used machine learning algorithms on genomic datasets for analysis and discovery of the gene regulatory networks. This knowledge is being used to discover new drug targets for genetic diseases like cancer. This paper has proposed an algorithm using partial correlation with data perturbation for inference of gene regulatory networks that are involved in incidence of blood malignancy called as multiple myeloma. The proposed method has been compared with existing methods and the results show superior performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Value and Strategy of Anime Elements in the Propaganda of COVID-19 Epidemic Situation based on Computer Vision Assisted Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Value and strategy of anime elements in the smart propaganda of the COVID-19 epidemic situation based on the computer vision assisted systems is analyzed in this paper. During the COVID-19 epidemic, the in-depth research on the popular cartoons and animation epidemic and the content of Internet has found that the acceptance of the people is high, and there are also many people who respond to the comics and the content of the illustrations is difficult to understand. After an in-depth investigation and analysis of this phenomenon, it was found that the inconsistent style of the picture, the vagueness of the picture-oriented and indicative, and the messy text layout are the key factors that cause the audience to not understand. Hence, this paper combines the computer vision and computer systems to construct the intelligent propaganda strategy. The computer processing of graphic images has a certain connection. In actual operation, the combination of graphics and image technology can reduce pressure of data operations in image operations and improve the visual effects of pictures. This property is used to show the performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Cost Efficient Subtractor Designs in QCA
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The increase in the number of challenges to CMOS technology at extreme Nanometer levels has pushed the research community to propose alternative technologies to realize circuits at Nanometer levels. Quantum-dot Cellular Automata is considered to be a possible technology that can be used instead of CMOS in extreme Nanometer circuit design. It is mainly due to the attractive features it promises to offer such as very fastness, compactness, and low power. Subtractor circuits are widely used in arithmetic and several signal processing applications. In this work, two cost efficient QCA subtractor circuits are proposed using majority logic. In order to design the circuits with more reliability, the circuits are realized by employing clock zone based crossover. Simulation results also validate that the proposed designs are cost-efficient. Both the designs can be stretched to realize any higher order QCA subtractor. Simulation verification is done in QCADesigner 2.0.3.

articleTitle: ResNet-based approach for Detection and Classification of Plant Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Crop disease is a serious concern for safety of food, but its fast detection still remains difficult in different parts of the world because of the lack of proper infrastructure. Automatic identification of plant diseases is necessary for food security, yield loss estimation and management of disease. With the worldwide increase in digital cameras and continuous improvement in computer vision domain, the automated techniques for detection of disease are highly in demands in precision agriculture, highly productive plant phenotype, smart greenhouse and much more. Working on an open dataset which includes 15200 images of crop leaves, a Residual Network (ResNet34) was trained to perform this task of classification. The proposed ResNet34 model accomplished a 99.40% accuracy on a test set, illustrating the viability of the proposed model. Overall, the process of training ResNet models on an open image dataset provides a sound way towards crop disease detection using automated networks on an enormous global scale.

articleTitle: Sentiment Identification in COVID-19 Specific Tweets
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In 2020, our world has been hit by a global pandemic of COVID-19, belonging to the family of Coronavirus. Due to the rapid increase in the infection and the death rate, people have started to develop mixed feelings regarding this situation. Therefore, in this study, our sole focus is to analyze the emotions expressed by people using social media such as Twitter etc. Accumulating and studying the concerning tweets will provide aid to elicitate the real emotions during this hard time. The goal of this study is to present a domain-specific approach to understand sentiments manifested within people around the globe regarding this situation. In order to attain this, corona-specific tweets are acquired from twitter platform. After gathering the tweets, they are labelled and a model is developed which is effective for detecting the actual sentiment behind a tweet related to COVID-19. The substantial assessments are performed in bi-class and multi-class setting over n-gram feature set along with cross-dataset evaluation of different machine learning techniques in order to develop the model. Our experiments reveal that the proposed model performs well in perceiving the perception of people about COVID-19 with a maximum accuracy of about 93%.

articleTitle: Image Processing System based Identification and Classification of Leaf Disease: A Case Study on Paddy Leaf
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Paddy is the main nourishment in the south sections of India. It straightforwardly influences the country's infrastructure. Bacterial leaf blight, brown spot and leaf smut were its main illnesses found in paddy field crops, which also significantly affect its profitability. This work presents an image processing system based automatic identification and classification of various paddy leaf diseases by affecting the cultivation of paddy namely bacterial leaf blight, brown spot, and leaf smut. The key phases of proposed methodology are pre-processing of images, segmentation, feature extraction and classification. The technique used in the proposed work to identify paddy leaf disease involves Otsu threshold method for segmentation, grey level co-occurrence metrics for feature extraction and k-nearest neighbors algorithm for classification. The proposed system aims at achieving rapid and accurate identification of disease and classification of the disease type and also helps in classifying the various paddy leaf diseases by utilizing the texture and shape features that majorly contributes in leaf disease recognition.

articleTitle: Automated Identification of Disaster News for Crisis Management using Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: We are living in unprecedented times and anyone in this world could be impacted by natural disasters in some way or the other. Life is unpredictable and what is to come is unforeseeable. Nobody knows what the very next moment will hold, maybe it could be a disastrous one too. The past cannot be changed but it can act constructively towards the betterment of the current situation, `Precaution is better than cure'. To be above this uncertain dilemma of life and death situations, `Automated Identification of Disaster News for Crisis Management is proposed using Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing'. A software solution that can help disaster management websites to dynamically show the disaster relevant news which can be shared to other social media handles through their sites. The objective here is to automatically scrape news from English news websites and identify disaster relevant news using natural language processing techniques and machine learning concepts, which can further be dynamically displayed on the crisis management websites. The complete model is automated and requires no manual labor at all. The architecture is based on Machine Learning principles that classifies news scraped from top news websites using a spider-scraper into two categories, one being disaster relevant news and other being disaster irrelevant news and eventually displaying the relevant disaster news on the crisis management website.

articleTitle: Clothing Image Recognition Based on Multiple Features Using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: For many online customers, clothing image recognition is used mainly in computer vision for fashion applications. Recognition of the clothing image and identification of their style and presentation make the problem difficult for the fashion item. Image recognition technologies allow consumers to scan a picture taken from a fashion magazine or print ad and automatically land on the product page where they can purchase the exact item. Retailers can propose similar looking items in different price ranges with visual search solutions running in the app or website, so the customer can buy a look-alike product at a lower price. The main focus is on classifying the MNIST fashion dataset using multilayer perceptron, convolutional neural network and extreme learning machine. Extracting the F-mnist dataset using these deep neural networks that are most common in computer vision for the implementation of image recognition and even more effective for cloth prediction evaluation. Fashion-MNIS T enhances cultural diversity by attracting more young women students, collectors, artists and designers. Selecting the right deep learning technique for extracting features and choosing the best model of classification remains a major challenge in achieving good quality accuracy. The experimental results, however, show that this Fashion-MNIST dataset has impressive results.

articleTitle: Satellite Image Classification for Detecting Unused Landscape using CNN
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: As the landscapes changes day by day it leads to the increasing use of unused lands, by which unused lands can be used for various purposes like agriculture, developing city infrastructure and many more. This paper helps in automating the process of detecting the unused land space. In this work, a system for satellite image processing that detects unused land is proposed. Here remote sensing earth images are taken as the dataset where the pre-processing step includes converting image into greyscale image, compression and noise removal. Segmentation is done to partition the region of used and unused lands. Feature extraction is done here using local binary feature extraction in-order to identify edge, flat and corner surfaces. As the mentioned various algorithm is used in classification and labeling of remote sensing earth images. CNN algorithm is also used for classification and labeling of classification is done automatically by the use of CNN algorithm. Random forest is used to segregate two landscapes as used and unused land which gives accuracy better than the existing systems.

articleTitle: Fruit Classification System Using Multiclass Support Vector Machine Classifier
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Fruit classification has always been a challenging task as it involves sorting, grading, and analyzing fruit quality specifically for import, consumption purposes and for workers at the Point of Sale (POS) in supermarkets. The proposed work has used computer vision and support vector machine (SVM), for classification. Among the fruit images collected, 505 fruit images are used in training and 150 fruit images are used in testing. The work is carried out in various stages. First, the input image is resized to 256×256 resolutions. Later, pre-processing is performed using Gaussian filter to enhance the image quality by reducing the noise. Feature space is created by extracting the colour, texture and shape features. Then, principal component analysis (PCA) is applied to reduce the dimensions of the feature space to overcome the curse of dimensionality. Further, the support vector machine (SVM) classifier is used for training the data. Total of 655 images distributed across 18 categories of fruits are maintained that achieves 87.06% accuracy.

articleTitle: ResNet: Detection of Invasive Ductal Carcinoma in Breast Histopathology Images Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Detection of Invasive Ductal Carcinoma (IDC) is a difficult, time taking and mandatory job. Moreover, the precise detection of IDC is important to give proper medical treatment to the patients. In this medical situation, Deep Learning (DL) approach is much reliable. The evolution of Deep Learning is taken off in the past few years due to a rise in more and more data, better hardware and it supports with robust computational modelling algorithms to train a framework. Based on the advantage of DL, a framework is introduced to automatically detect IDC in Breast Histopathology Images (BHI) of Breast Cancer (BC) either as a malign or benign. This ResNet is provided with labelled BHI data to extract common features and trained to classify the future images thus able to detect the presence of IDC in breast tissue lesion image. It takes less effort, gives better accuracy within less time. Thus our framework helps to speed up a pathologist's work and provides diagnosis support.

articleTitle: A Review on Traditional Methods of Condition Monitoring of Transformer
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Transformers is the most basic entity in a power system and is considered to be the heart of the whole power system. The capacity of these transformers can vary from low voltages amperes (few kVAs) to very high voltages amperes (MVAs). Damage or misfunctioning of transformer lead to a very catastrophic disaster. So, health and proper condition of these instruments is very crucial for a power system to work reliably and continuously. Continuous condition monitoring which includes many traditional and advance methods is now-a-days very much popular as it reduces maintenance time and cost, increases the life span and helps in finding the fault location in transformer easily. In this paper, comparison of all the traditional condition monitoring techniques alongside with their respective reason, interpretation and limitation is done which will help to understand better about the traditional techniques.

articleTitle: Securing Logs of a System - An IoTA Tangle Use Case
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Outbreak of the Internet and technological dependence make the Cyber Technology Industry grow at a very fast pace. Cyber-security is the dire need of today which helps prevent or defend the systems from cyber-attacks. Distributed Ledger Technology like Blockchain with its various properties and advantages opens many opportunities for its use in the cyber-security domain and mitigating the associated risks. These technologies remove the need of any central trusted party or authority, which would facilitate recording and tracking of resources. This paper focuses on the use of Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) in the field of Cyber-security. It focuses on the discussion of new distributed ledger technology IOTA, its features and working. This paper also focuses on one of the uses of the IOTA Tangle technology, which provides a solution for securing logs of a system. As the logs of a system are the most important evidence in the investigation phase of Cyber-Forensics, thus preserving the logs securely and maintaining their integrity is mandatory. Later in this paper, the use of IOTA is demonstrated for securing the logs of a system.

articleTitle: A Survey on Data-Driven Methods for State of Charge Estimation of Battery
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Battery Management System (BMS) is a type of an electronic regulator used to protect and monitor the battery, estimating the state and finally indicating it to the users. Precise valuation of the State of Charge (SOC) of the battery is an essential parameter in BMS, where SOC denotes the charge left in the battery. A decent estimation of SOC can lead to the longevity of the battery and avoid hazardous battery failures. Factors like overcharging or over-discharging can be eliminated by using a BMS. Various types of methods are present for accurate estimation of SOC. In this paper, a few Data-Driven methods are surveyed that are used for SOC estimation. Data-Driven methods apply complex algorithms on a huge amount of battery data to learn the behavior of the battery. Hence it outperforms other methods in case the system is not fully understood. A comparative study on the commonly used Data-Driven methods is conducted. Methods like Support Vector Machine (SVM), Fuzzy Logic (FL), Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and Deep Learning have been reviewed. These methods are been compared based on various parameters like computation cost, accuracy, amount of storage error percentage and many more parameters.

articleTitle: Arduino based Conventional Headlight with Multi Trait
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the present condition, a maximum fatal accident happens throughout the night time. In most instances, the late identity of an upcoming vehicle becomes the main reason. These situations give the front headlight structures a key function in vehicles. In order to improve the visibility of the upcoming vehicle, this paper mainly focused on replacing conventional headlight with multi featured automatic headlight system. This work aims to build a headlight system that improves visibility in the direction of travel., and it also reduces the vehicle damages. This paper focuses on Movable headlight(both left/right and up/down) in hilly areas as well as curved roads and also overcome the blind spot; Dimming of light for the solution for catastrophic accidents, based on an oncoming vehicle as well as vehicle speed and make it efficient enough to switch excessive beam as well as in reasonable price.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Heartbeat Rate and SpO2 Detector by Using IoT for Patients
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this modern days, development of smart healthcare system is an emerging area of research on the Internet of Thing (IoT). The majority of the individuals who are living in provincial territories are not able to get medical services because of the absence of specialists, emergency and private clinics. Likewise, notwithstanding a little medical issue, the individuals get wavered to get counsel from a specialist due to travel, cost, and time. The heart is the most vital organ in the human body, and the heartbeat rate is an essential aspect of human metabolism. Pulse oximetry is the non-invasive measurement of the oxygen saturation (SpO2) in the heart. However, most of the available heart rate measurement tools are rather expensive and only available in hospitals, and accurate measurement of SpO2 in a rural area may not be possible immediately to measure the level of oxygen level in the human body. In this proposed system, Beer's Law used to implement the Heart Beat Rate, and SpO2 detector used to measure SpO2, heartbeat rate and temperature range. Two different light wavelengths (Red Led and Infrared Led) are used to measure the actual difference in the absorption spectra between HbO2 and Hb. The SpO2 probe placed on the person's finger and the other end with a micro controller to calculate the number of pulses and the amount of the SpO2 present on their body. The measurement range of the SpO2, Heart Beat Rate and Temperature are viewed via OP APP (Outpatient Android Application) and the same is viewed by the doctor in the other end through the cloud. Besides, the interaction will be done between the clinician and patient through video conference in the same OP APP.

articleTitle: Survey and Gap Analysis of Word Sense Disambiguation Approaches on Unstructured Texts
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD) is considered as one of the pivotal problems of Semantic classification among polysemous words that can be addressed using Natural Language Processing (NLP) for identifying the sense of the ambiguous word in a particular context. The application areas of WSD pertain to machine translation, information extraction and retrieval (IE-IR), dialogue systems, and automatic summarization kind of NLP solutions. This paper presents a survey on WSD approaches in major AI-NLP methods by comparing different approaches for WSD in supervised, unsupervised, and knowledge based algorithms. This paper also aims at providing gap analysis in surveyed WSD systems comparing strengths and weaknesses of various surveyed systems and their accuracy. Based on the findings, a future hybrid approach synergizing rule-based and machine learning based methods are contemplated. The findings of this survey are envisaged through an ongoing research on WSD based Meta-Search algorithm under C-DAC purview for an Intelligent NLP based system to detect the actual sense of search queries and providing semantic classification of news headlines and snippets containing ambiguous words.

articleTitle: Big Data Analytics Tools and Applications for Modern Business World
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the modern world, data is the unavoidable word. The digital environment in almost all our day to day life is linked with digital data. Effective data management is one of the important tasks. The gradual growth of technology in recent years, the generation of data has increased exponentially. Everything, ranging from sending a mail to simply browsing the internet generates data and this is collected and stored. This data has countless uses in various fields such as medicine, business, agriculture and marketing, but most of the time it goes unused. Business intelligence is a key factor in the current business world. Business growth is purely depending on technology. Technology is not only used in manufacturing it is applied to getting the customer. The data analytics is still in its earlier stages and has a long way to go before it yields favourable results. It is a good time as any to start working in this domain to utilize its prowess. This article has discussed the opportunities and growth of data analytics in the research domain. It can face soon when it reaches its advance stages. The big data is handling a larger amount of data in a conventional and non-conventional manner. Technology is playing a vital role to handle larger data from the database. This article is to discuss data analytics application in modern industry. In the technical perspective, big data Map-reduce is an advanced tool and for simulation part, R tool is used.

articleTitle: Software Defined Radio based Global Positioning System Jamming and Spoofing for Vulnerability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In recent days, the uses for Global Positioning System (GPS) has increased as now everyone has mobile phones with GPS in it. GPS data is also used in military as it provides the information about location and time which are important factors in various applications. So, the issues of vulnerability for GPS increase with extensive utilization of GPS data by public as well as defense organizations. And when vulnerability increases it becomes easier opportunity for attacker to attack the system. Here two types of attacks are modeled, one where the GPS signal may interfere with the authentic signal and second where the attacker provides wrong information to users about their location by creating forged signal with fake location address and time. The aim of this paper is to achieve successful jamming and spoofing attack using Software Define Radio (SDR). These results can contribute to speed up research on anti-jamming as well as anti-spoofing technology in order to make the GPS more secured for its users and other applications. Some points are also emphasized on anti-spoofing techniques for future research.

articleTitle: Enhancing Multi-Step Attack Prediction using Hidden Markov Model and Naive Bayes
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Attacks that occur in a series of stages are termed as Multi-stage attacks. These attacks follow a path, wherein each stage is an attack in itself. Traditional Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) are less capable of predicting such attacks. In this paper, Machine Learning models have been built that are most widely used and ideal for prediction. These two models are the Hidden Markov Model (HMM) and Naive Bayes. These models are built using the famous KDDCUP'99 network intrusion dataset. The paper also proposes a multi-stage Naive Bayes architecture that predicts each stage of the multi-stage attack scenario. The paper does a comparative study of these two models based on the accuracy of prediction. Experiments carried out in this research prove HMMs to give higher accuracy compared to Naive Bayes.

articleTitle: Analysis of Overloading in Trucks using Embedded Controller
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The primary cause for the rise in accidents is because of vehicle overloading, drunk driving.
